integrity: Mathematical proof, direct exhaustive finite transition checker, and an independent finite numerical spectral checker are supplied. Previously known middle-level eigenvalues are credited; all infinite assertions depend on the proof rather than finite tests.
scientific_limitations: The finite-state result concerns only labelled graphs formed by deleting a perfect matching from the complete graph, and uniform closed-neighborhood minority updates. The exact gap is only for the odd-parameter recurrent irreducible chain. Hitting times and worst-case mixing from arbitrary initial states are not determined. Absolute literature priority and independent scientific validation are not claimed.
title: Parity transition and exact relaxation gap for asynchronous minority on cocktail-party graphs
